title: Man. Post. Cap. IX: PLAC — being in Adam before peccare; not by imputation of his being
pass_a_gloss: You say all sinned in Adam. Being is prior to acting. You will not say we were in Adam by an imputation of his being; why then sin in him by an imputation of his sinning?
pass_b_english: Next you will have all to have sinned in Adam. But you will grant that they were in Adam in the way they sinned in Adam: for it is prior to be than to act or to sin. Were we therefore in Adam by an imputation of his being? You will deny it far from doubt: why then will you have us to have sinned in him by an imputation of his sinning?
source_text: Deinde tu vis omnes peccasse in Adamo. Dabis autem fuisse in Adamo quomodo in Adamo peccaverunt: prius enim est esse quam agere vel peccare. Fuimusne ergo in Adamo imputatione qua esse eius? negabis procul dubio: cur ergo vis nos in eo peccasse imputatione qua peccare ipsius?

choices.choice: No imputed being-in-Adam; then no imputed sinning-in-Adam either
